messages.subject: Change axis limits with gm.prcomp/plot.gm.prcomp
parts:
Hello there! 

I am attempting to change the x- and y-axis limits for a phylomorphospace produced by plot.gm.prcomp. Since I am generating a phylomorphospace, additional arguments are passed to the phylogeny and not the plot. This means xlim and ylim are ignored. 

Is there a specific way to change the axis limitations when generating a phylomorphospace?

Below is a screenshot of my code and plot (you can see that plot limitations do not match the xlim and ylim).


Thank you,
-Corinthia Black

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Change axis limits with gm.prcomp/plot.gm.prcomp
parts:
Hi Corinthia,

Thanks for finding this!  This is actually a bug in the RRPP package (plot.ordinate function), not geomorph, owing to a missing logical condition for xlim and ylim (which turns these parameters into an override of yours).  I have updated the code and the update is available via Github,

 devtools::install_github("mlcollyer/RRPP”, build_vignettes = TRUE)

Cheers!
Mike

Thanks for all the help.

messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Change axis limits with gm.prcomp/plot.gm.prcomp
parts:
I cannot reproduce this and it seems to work, irrespective of order, on my computer.  Do you get a warning message but still get the plot?  With plot parameters, a misspelled argument won’t throw an error but just a warning, still making the plot with the arguments it has.  (For example, if you use xlin or xlims or something that was not readily recognized as misspelled.)

You can try to send me your data and script outside of the google group and I can try to diagnose this particular problem.  Or maybe just restarting R can sometimes solve these quirks.

I’m not sure what to suggest without a more precise knowledge of the problem I cannot create.  

Best,

Mike
